views.name: repos_sample_basic
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  r."repo_name" AS repo_name,
  r."watch_count" AS watch_count,
  ANY_VALUE(l."license") AS license,
  COUNT(f."path") AS sample_file_count
FROM GITHUB_REPOS_DATE.GITHUB_REPOS.SAMPLE_REPOS r
LEFT JOIN GITHUB_REPOS_DATE.GITHUB_REPOS.LICENSES l
  ON r."repo_name" = l."repo_name"
LEFT JOIN GITHUB_REPOS_DATE.GITHUB_REPOS.SAMPLE_FILES f
  ON r."repo_name" = f."repo_name"
GROUP BY r."repo_name", r."watch_count"
views.description: Clean projection of SAMPLE_REPOS joined with LICENSES and SAMPLE_FILES counts per repo. Provides one-row-per-repo with basic measures like watch_count and file_count. Useful as a repo-level dimension for analyses of sample repos. | Use for: Rank repos by watch_count or file_count; Join repo metadata to sample commit or language details; Filter repos by presence/absence of license or files

views.name: languages_exploded
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  "repo_name" AS repo_name,
  l.value::variant AS language_variant,
  -- attempt to extract a simple string label when language is a scalar
  CASE WHEN TYPEOF(l.value) = 'OBJECT' THEN OBJECT_KEYS(l.value)[0] ELSE NULL END AS language_key_guess,
  CASE WHEN TYPEOF(l.value) = 'STRING' THEN l.value::string ELSE NULL END AS language_name_simple,
  CASE WHEN TYPEOF(l.value) = 'OBJECT' THEN l.value::variant ELSE NULL END AS language_object
FROM GITHUB_REPOS_DATE.GITHUB_REPOS.LANGUAGES,
LATERAL FLATTEN(input => "language") l
views.description: Unnests the VARIANT language column for each repo into language_name and optional bytes/counts if present. Produces one row per repo-language discovered in the VARIANT. Useful when LANGUAGES.language contains maps like {"Python": 12345, ...} or arrays. | Use for: Count repos by detected languages; Join language usage to repo watch counts or file counts; Filter repos containing a particular language key

views.name: sample_commits_basic
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  "commit" AS commit,
  "tree" AS tree,
  "parent" AS parent_variant,
  "author" AS author_variant,
  "committer" AS committer_variant,
  "subject" AS subject,
  "message" AS message,
  "repo_name" AS repo_name,
  "encoding" AS encoding
FROM GITHUB_REPOS_DATE.GITHUB_REPOS.SAMPLE_COMMITS
views.description: Normalized projection of SAMPLE_COMMITS extracting common commit-level fields and exposing VARIANT columns for later JSON extraction. One row per commit (commit id preserved). | Use for: Find commits by repo or author fields inside author_variant; Join commits to sample_repos by repo_name; Extract parent commit relationships for simple lineage queries

views.name: github_events_basic
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  "id" AS id,
  "type" AS type,
  "public" AS public,
  "payload" AS payload_variant,
  "repo" AS repo_variant,
  "actor" AS actor_variant,
  "org" AS org_variant,
  "created_at" AS created_at
FROM GITHUB_REPOS_DATE.MONTH._201104
grain: one row per GitHub event (as available in the shard)
views.description: Normalized, minimal projection of a month/year-sharded GitHub events table. Selects core columns and preserves VARIANT columns for downstream JSON parsing. Use when scanning events across shards. | Use for: Aggregate events by type or time window; Extract repo or actor identifiers from the VARIANT columns; Join events across month/year shards
